thread:
Elena: Polaris Labs asked for a short POC on Dedicated. They want a guaranteed capacity reservation for a live demo next month. Asking for 6 A100-equivalent GPUs in eu-west-1 for ~36h. Also need a pool name, scoped API key expiring after the window, and VPC peering prep. Can someone own the provisioning + fast quote?

Dustin: I’ll own provisioning and autoscale config. Quick check: is guaranteed reservation required or would they accept a reserved headroom + burst credits? Also need rough peak qps and token lengths.

Elena: They explicitly asked for guaranteed (no evictions). Peak ~2k reqs/min, typical seq length ~350 tokens.

InfraBot: Available capacity in eu-west-1 looks OK. For guaranteed we must create a short-lived reserved pool (billable by hour). Alternative is burst credits (best-effort) with no PO.

Priya: Security note: before any peering we need signed DPA, proof of SOC2 or equivalent, and the customer-managed KMS or an approved KMS policy. Also require an allowlist of source CIDRs. Flagging @Security.

Security: Confirmed. Also require a service account for the customer and a short questionnaire (3 items: allowed data types, retention window, and admin contacts). We'll also want confirmation that demo data excludes sensitive PII.

Finance: For a ballpark: $22/hr per A100-equivalent GPU (volume discount applied). 6 GPUs -> $132/hr. For 36 hours = $4,752. Add $250 one-time ops fee. Quote $5.1k to be safe. We can issue an invoice or accept credit card for immediate provisioning.

Dustin: Autoscale policy proposal (we'll attach to the reserved pool):

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 12
  metrics: request_qps
  target_qps_per_replica: 200
  burst_policy:
    reserved_gpus: 6
    guarantee: guaranteed
    scale_down_delay_seconds: 600
```

Dustin: Note: guaranteed reserve blocks other tenants from using those GPUs for the window; customers are billed for the reservation even if underutilized.

Elena: Customer requested a scoped API key that expires after the demo and is limited to the pool. Can we do API key TTL + IP restriction?

InfraBot: Yes. We can create a pool-scoped key with TTL and optional CIDR allowlist. Example client snippet: 

```bash
# short-lived key example (issued for pool "polaris-poc-eu1")
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=polaris-poc-YYYYYY
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-quant","input":"status"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/instances/polaris-poc-eu1/generate
```

Priya: For peering please have customer provide: ASN, public endpoint IPs, allowed CIDR ranges, and preferred peering window. We'll also need the routing policy (static or dynamic).

Elena: Proposed reservation window from customer: start=2026-04-05T09:00:00Z end=2026-04-06T21:00:00Z. Billing contact: acct@polaris-labs.com, PO pending. They can provide a card to start. Pool name to create: polaris-poc-eu1. VPC CIDR: 10.50.0.0/16.

Finance: OK to provision after card or PO. I'll draft the $5.1k estimate and include an optional soft-burst fallback that avoids PO and uses burst credits (non-guaranteed).

Security: I'll send the short questionnaire and DPA link. Reserve note: we need the questionnaire returned before peering is enabled.

InfraBot: Tentative provisioning ETA once approvals + payment + questionnaire complete = ~3 hours. If they want immediate hard-reserve before DPA, we can provision but lock peering until DPA + questionnaire are done.

Dustin: I'll queue the pool and prepare the runbook for the customer with sample configs and a brief rollback plan. Runbook will include: how to swap keys post-demo, how to cancel reservation early (prorated), and how to switch to soft-burst afterwards.

Elena: Great. I'll chase PO/card and security answers. Will update once we have signed DPA and payment. Thanks all :rocket:
